sources.summary: ISOCARP Women in Planning is entering an exciting new chapter! This November in Glasgow, the Women in Planning Awards will be held for the first time as a standalone awards ceremony accompanied by a full day of engaging sessions and activities! Submit your nominations in three Pillars: 1. Inspiring Individuals 2. Inclusive and Equitable Organisational Culture 3. Gender-Responsive Planning Practice, Policy & Research
